'''Nalla''' was a [[Da'shain Aiel]] who lived during the [[Age of Legends]] in the city of [[V'saine]].  

==History==

Nalla proposed marriage to [[Charn]] shortly before Charn witnesses the opening of the bore. She may a distant ancestor of [[Rand]]. She serves [[Zorelle]] Sedai.{{ref/book|4|26}}
